description: Report the user's current plan and usage: their tier (Free or Premium), how many projects and how much storage they are using against their limits, their subscription status if any, and where they manage their plan. Use this when the user asks what plan they are on, how much storage or how many projects they have used, or whether they are near a limit. Metadata only - no files, facts, or profile content. This is READ-ONLY: you cannot change the plan or start a purchase; plan and billing changes are done by the user themselves at usemycontext.ai. Read-only; nothing is written, so it is safe to call.
name: account

currentPeriodEnd.description: The current billing-period end (ms epoch), when known.

subscriptionStatus.description: The Stripe subscription status, when the user has a subscription.

upgradeUrl.description: Where the user manages their plan and billing.

storageUsedBytes.description: Total bytes stored across projects, or null when the storage read is temporarily unavailable.

title: Your plan and usage
